title: Lowell House Resident Dean
bio: I am so excited to enter my fourth year in this amazing community as the Lowell Resident Dean! My role is to support you in your unique experience at Harvard, with the understanding that your personal, physical, mental, social, spiritual, etc. well-being is tied to your academic well-being. I am here to help you with any academic or personal issues; if I don't have the answer, I will make sure to guide you to someone who can help you. I'm a non-judgmental listener and confidant, and having had my fair share of life experiences, I am shocked at nothing. While I grew up in many places, including many cities in Southern California, Arizona, Las Vegas, and South Korea, I've now spent the longest period of my life in Boston. I come from an immigrant family and was a FGLI student at Williams College. After graduation, I spent a year working abroad in Chile, and then I completed my PhD in the Biological and Biomedical Sciences program here at Harvard studying the bacterium that causes tuberculosis. After deciding research was not for me, I started working as a TA for Ls1a, Ls1b, and GenEd 1004. I spent the three years as a preceptor for Ls1b and am now also a lecturer in MCB. You can reach out to me with anything! Academic advising questions, family issues, roommate problems, etc! Community Lowell House Role Residential Allston Burr Resident Deans
